# Draft:World Conquest (Roblox)

World Conquest is a Roblox experience with around 21M visits as of December 2025 and can be classified as part of the Stud Roleplay Game Genre which revolves around the usage of Roblox's chat system to communicate roleplay and justify actions in game. Painting without roleplay is seen as a break of the World Conquest rules. It is owned by Marqret, a prominent member of the World Conquest community since it was founded in 2011. It has a Discord server which is often used for members of the community to converse with one another.
It is often criticized for strictness on new players and is disliked by many other communities in the genre, however it still remains the Second Biggest.
